multiple_total_revenue_concepts: Require equal amounts for the same exact interval; no preference or summing components.
current_flow_interval: Longest revenue-and-NetIncomeLoss interval ending on original report_end within the form bounds. No fallback to shorter intervals when selected facts conflict.
prior_comparable: Exactly one revenue interval with both endpoints 350-380 days earlier and duration differing by at most7 days. At least one same revenue concept must be present in current and prior intervals.
duplicates: Same concept/period/unit exact decimal agreement permitted; conflicting values make arithmetic unready, never last-row wins.
instant_facts: Assets and Liabilities must share the exact original report end.
valid_denominators: Current/prior revenue and assets strictly positive; liabilities nonnegative. Net income may be negative.
period_kind: Reported annual or longest reported subannual interval, not assumed calendar quarter, YTD or trailing-twelve-month estimate.
coherent_vintage: Every value comes from one original accession. Comparative restatements are available only with that accession; never rewrite an earlier snapshot.
units: Unqualified expected-issuer simple USD facts only; no currency conversion or scale refit.
inorganic_growth: Reported ratios, not organic growth or proof of economic comparability across reorganizations/mergers.
publication_identity_price_link_and_stal: Still required before any dataset or model input.
